LESSON: BASIC CHANTS/MANTRAS AS PER BUDDHISM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: General
Strand: Worship
Topic 4.1: Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism, part of Worship in Grade 6 General.

Key inquiry question: how to apply pancha sila in real life. How is recitation of chants/ mantras important in Buddhist occasions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
